batting.dismissal: c C Green b SR Dubey

batting.name: Naman Dhir
batting.dismissal: c A Raghuvanshi b C Green

batting.name: Tilak Varma
batting.dismissal: c AS Roy b Kartik Tyagi

batting.dismissal: c AS Roy b Kartik Tyagi

batting.name: C Green
batting.dismissal: c AM Ghazanfar b C Bosch

batting.dismissal: c RD Rickelton b C Bosch

balls.text: caught at deep backward point off the last ball of the innings, slower short ball, Chahar backed away and carved it high and straight to Anukul Roy in the deep, MI finish with 147 when it looked like they would get much less at one stage
short ball, Bosch pulls hard and along the ground but can't find the gap on the square leg boundary
full ball outside off, Bosch mistimes the drive into the ground and over the bowler towards long on, Bosch calls for two, Chahar has to race back to beat Rinku's throw and he does!
Tyagi bangs it in fast and short this time but Bosch responds with the hook, gets an edge on to his helmet and the ball races to the fine leg boundary
and again! Tyagi is feeding him some slot balls, and even though this was the offcutter Bosch made superb connection with his mow across the line, heaving it over deep midwicket
length ball angling into Bosch and he swings across the line and makes great contact, sending it over the deep midwicket boundary, great wrists
full and wide again from over the wicket across the right-hander, this time Chahar carves it over point and to the boundary with another lunge and a full swing of the bat
the attempted wide yorker gone wrong, Chahar lunges for it wide outside off and gets a bit of bat on it, enough to send the ball scurrying wide of the fielder at short third
wild swing across the line at one that angles across him from over the wicket, slower one from Dubey and Chahar is beaten

full ball slanting across the right-hander from over the wicket, Chahar misses with his swing and then reviews the umpire's decision to not call that a wide. There's a fraction of the ball within the guide line so it's a fair delivery
gets down on one knee right across his stumps to try and paddle the ball past short fine leg, doesn't make proper contact but manages to get the ball behind square leg
full ball and Bosch drives with power straight past the bowler, long off had no chance of stopping that
the fielder at midwicket dives over the ball after Chahar swings hard at it and gets a thick inside edge along the ground, Manish Pandey it was
fuller length outside off at 142.5 kph, Chahar prods away from his body without moving his feet and gets beaten as the ball moves away from him
punched towards wide mid-off for a single
this time the short ball sits up for Bosch and he nails the pull shot into the gap on the deep midwicket boundary, cracking sound off the bat
short of a length again outside off, mis-times the pull through midwicket
short of a length delivery springs up at Bosch just outside off and holds its line, Bosch tries to play across the line and gets beaten
Varun's done with his spell, Bosch nudges the last ball through mid on for a single
beaten outside the off stump as he tries to reverse swat the ball, that was quite wide outside off

has Jacks been run out?! KKR think so. He's short at the bowler's end when Varun breaks the stumps. Jacks is fuming as he walks off. He wanted a second run after hitting the ball to deep point, but got sent back by Bosch, who barely moved after completing the single. Rinku's throw from the deep to Varun was accurate and Jacks had no chance even with the dive.
goes around the wicket and slants the ball at speed across the hander, too wide
fetch that from the stands beyond deep midwicket! Jacks gets down on one knee and mows across the line, connecting with immense power
angled in towards the stumps, Bosch goes back and works the ball through mid on
cut off the back foot through point for a single
zips past the outside edge of Bosch's tentative prod on the front foot, Narine has been wizardly on this pitch, no one has a read on him yet
tries to force it through the off side and gets a bottom edge into the ground back to the bowler
slower through the air, Bosch tries to play across the line again but can't connect
raps the pads with one that slides into the right-hander, Bosch was on the front foot and playing across the line, that would have missed leg
stumps are in disarray! Narine zips the ball ball into the right-hander, attacking the stumps, the ball keeps a touch low too and Hardik was so late on the cut, missed that by a long way
spins away from the right-hander from a good length outside off, Jacks goes back and punches through covers
short of a length delivery outside off , that was quite wide and Hardik could not reach it with his cut shot
tries to loft the ball down the ground but gets beaten outside off, really went hard at that one, that was pace off from Green

tries to slam a short of a length ball down the ground with a flat bat and misses, beaten by the bounce, but hang on, KKR appeal for a caught behind and they are reviewing the not out decision. It wasn't a strong appeal and ultra edge shows no spike, KKR lose a review
135.3 kph on a good length around middle and off, Jacks moves forward and drives to long on
swings hard again and hits it through square leg, Green's length is on the fuller side
hit with tremendous power, clearing his front foot and smashing a full ball past the bowler, beats long-off easily to his right
short ball, big swing across the line, top edge, the substitute keeper Tejasvi leaps in the air with his right hand outstretched to try and catch the ball as it flies past, he can't
short ball outside off stump, Jacks drops his wrists and lets it go

Tilak's difficult innings is at an end, he falls by pulling a quick short ball to deep backward square leg, that was 141 kph and it hurried Tilak for time on the pull shot, only the second time this season that a batter has faced 30+ balls and scored at less than a run a ball
pace off this time and Hardik has to wait and then pull along the ground to deep midwicket, didn't time it all that well
serious bounce from Tyagi, hurrying Hardik for time with another sharp short ball, beating the pull shot, that was measured at 136.5 kph, but looked quicker
wow, there was heat on that ball outside off, and it bounced sharply on Hardik from short of a length, he was late on the cut shot and beaten
tries to hit hard across the line and gets a thick inside edge through midwicket
pushed into the off side for a single
stays in his crease and punches a quickish ball into the covers
punched firmly to long on for a single
flat over deep midwicket, didn't look like he timed it all that well but well enough, Varun dragged it a bit short, giving Hardik the space to pull
tries to hit it hard through the off side but gets a bottom edge into the ground
pitches outside leg and spins across the left-hander, Tilak plays back and gets an edge on the off side
played into the leg side, Narine runs across to field
played back towards the bowler
defended on the off side
he's made great contact this time, slamming the ball powerfully over deep midwicket, down on one knee and wham
blocked tentatively on the off side
played from the crease close on the leg side

dropped, that's gone straight up in the air, another skier, and when the ball comes down there are two people under it - Varun the bowler and the keeper Raghuvanshi, Varun ended up catching it and then made contact with the keeper and the ball spilled out of his hands as he hit the ground. Tilak had swung hard across the line, but only hit it as far as the non-striker's end, what was Raghuvanshi thinking running all the way when Varun was so close to it
steered off the back foot towards short third for a quick single
played off the back foot gently in front of square leg
Tilak is struggling against spin on this pitch, tries to reverse whack one that spins across him from over the wicket and misses
presses forward and flicks the ball off his front pad through square leg
worked off the pads behind square

that's the one that spins away from the right-hander from a good length outside off stump, Hardik thinks it is spinning into him and tries to play with the angle into him on the leg side and gets beaten on the outside edge
waits late in his crease for the ball to spin across him and dabs it towards point
defended on the front foot, bat on ball this time
beaten as he presses forward to defend and the ball spins past his outside edge
angled across Hardik from around the wicket, pitches outside leg and slants across the right-hander as he closes the face of the bat to play on the leg side and gets an outside edge on the off side
good length spinning into Hardik from outside off, punched from the crease into the covers
pitches outside leg and spins towards the pads, worked off the back foot behind square
brings out the reverse sweep and hits it to point from outside leg stump
cut off the back foot to point
banged in short and it gets rather high on Tilak who pulls through midwicket
played off the back foot on the leg side, Varun does seem to be struggling with his foot
played off the back foot through midwicket
tries to budge the ball on the leg side but gets hit on the pad, Narine proving extremely tricky for Tilak to read at the moment
that's gone between the keeper and the first slip, and the umpire signals byes. So no bat, just a lot of turn and bounce that beat Tilak's prod comprehensively
strides forward and pushes a good length ball from outside off into the covers
nudged off the pads behind square
bowled slowly pitching in line with the stumps and spinning across Tilak who stays in his crease and pokes and gets beaten
kept a touch low outside off, Hardik slashed at it from his crease and was beaten
jumps back and pushes a short of a length ball towards point to bring up MI's 50
steps out and slaps the ball in the air over cover, just clears the fielder in the circle, not timed well and Anukul runs to his right on the sweeper boundary and stops the ball with his foot
banged in short and Tilak ducks under it, umpire signals a bouncer
strays on to the pads, clipped behind square leg for a single
full and on off and middle, Hardik stays in his crease and flicks it to midwicket
short of a length at the body from over the wicket, Hardik moves across his stumps as the ball angles across him and plays it close on the leg side
slashes at a wide one this time and gets a thick edge down to the vacant deep third region, too wide outside off from Dubey, Hardik looks like he's in a mood
charges down the pitch first ball and tries to hit it out of the ground with an almighty swing, he misses

strong comeback from Dubey! Goes around the wicket to angle the ball into the right-hander, and he has Sky chopping on to his stumps. The length was shorter and there was room outside off and Sky went at it really hard, flaying his bat away from his body to try and crash that delivery through the offside, instead he got a bottom edge
another six over the long-leg boundary, Sky moves his front foot slightly across his stumps, gets a bit low to get under the ball and sends it on its way with a strong flick of the wrists
length outside off, Tilak stays on the back foot and cuts to point
the yorker, beginning at the towering height of Green's upright arm and ending near Sky's toes, he digs it out
slightly fuller length outside off, Tilak stays back and pushes the ball towards point for a single
the short of a length ball from around the wicket gets big on Tilak, who jumps back and defends
good length outside off, Sky stays in his crease and runs it behind point by opening the face of his bat
drifts down the leg side and Sky helps it along to the fine leg boundary by moving across his stumps and getting some bat on it
languid drive, well timed, on the up, straight past the bowler for his first boundary, so easy on the eye
defended on the back foot
the full ball swings away from the left-hander, too wide outside off

another skier, again the ball takes an age to land, and when it does it is Green getting under it, running towards midwicket from mid-on and judging it perfectly, Rohit tried to pull that ball into oblivion and played his shot a touch too early. Exceptional catch from Green especially since Powell was also running back from midwicket and would have been in his eye line
short of a length and straighter at the body, Rohit stays in his crease and defends
over long leg! Don't see Rohit play these shots often, gets down on one knee outside off and paddles the fullish ball high and far over long leg for his second six
Rohit steps out a bit too early and then has to fend awkwardly at a short of a length ball that squares him up a touch and beats his outside edge
angles the ball across the right-hander on a fullish length from over the wicket, Rohit pushes forward at it but gets beaten

Green and the keeper Raghuvanshi are celebrating the caught behind but the umpire is unmoved! KKR review immediately. Dhir poked a long way away from his body, his feet going no where, at a good length ball that shaped away from him, there's a spike on ultra edge all right and Dhir is out of here, two in the over for Green. as he walks off, Dhir looks like he can't quite believe he's been given out here
beaten outside the off stump once again, the length is shorter and the line wider and Dhir hangs his bat out at it
prods tentatively at a fullish ball outside off without moving his feet and gets beaten, that moved away a touch

he's swung across the line to a good length ball too early and gets a top edge that goes so high in the air, takes an age to come down, and when it does Manish Pandey is the fielder under the catch in the point region ... it's a proper swirler and Pandey dives forward and judges it superbly.
a bit of extra bounce outside off and Rohit's attempt at forcing the good length ball through the offside results in a bottom edge past his stumps

that length ball has disappeared! A length ball angling into the right-hander, Rohit plants his front foot forward and swings hard across the line, sending the ball soaring and over the deep backward square leg boundary
length ball on the pads, Rohit tries to swing it away behind square but fails to make contact and gets hit on the thigh
the yorker dips late on Rohit who stays in his crease and jams his bat down on it in the nick of time
a rare fumble from Manish Pandey at point allows the single, there was width on offer outside off and Rickelton gave that a crack off the back foot
too wide outside off stump, Rickelton has a swish at it but the ball is out of reach
waits on the back foot and dabs a length ball behind point
Rohit gets hit in the groin by a short of a length ball, ouch. He was through the pull shot way too early, that ball gripped and came off the pitch slowly
good length from over the wicket angling across the right-hander, Rohit stays in his crease and defends
aims for the big slog sweep behind square and misses, Anukul appeals for lbw but that pitched well outside leg stump
nudged off the pads to midwicket
tries to play the ball on the leg side and gets an outside edge towards short third
finds the gap at cover, goes back in his crease to one that is just a bit wide outside off and punches crisply between the two fielders in the in-field
darted it flat and straight on middle and leg, Rohit stays back and flicks it off his pads through square
bowled on a wicket to wicket line from over the wicket, Rickelton goes back and hits it to long on
it's all over, finally! Rinku lofts back over the bowler's head to hit the winning boundary and end a scrappy contest at Eden Gardens. KKR stay alive in the race for the final playoff spot.
pushed towards midwicket from the crease
tries to loft the ball over the covers but gets an edge that goes high into the air again, Dhir is the fielder that comes running in from the sweeper boundary and dives but can't reach it
gets squared up by one that turns across him and the leading edge goes towards cover
tries to drive expansively through the off side and gets an edge that falls short of short third
short of a length angling across the left-hander, steered to deep third

another mix up involving Deepak Chahar and a high catch and this time Rickelton holds on to it! Tejasvi swings at a short of a length ball and top edges it towards long leg, Rickelton runs back and to his left from his keeping position, Chahar runs in from the long leg boundary, Rickelton ends up diving over Chahar as he takes the catch ... there was some contact between the players and Chahar is in some pain, holding his leg
the outside edge runs to the deep third boundary, Tejasvi was trying to turn that ball from a good length outside off towards the leg side
tries to turn a short of a length ball off his hips on the leg side and gets a leading edge that pops up on the off side, falling short of point
gets hit on the helmet by a short ball after he misses the swivel-pull, that smashed into the grille and the physio is out to have a look ... Tejasvi is already the concussion sub for Raghuvanshi
inside edge on to the pad as Tejasvi aims to swing a full ball through the leg side
short of a length at the body, Tejasvi moves across his stumps and works the ball behind square
pushed off the back foot to mid on
opens the face on the back foot and runs the ball to deep third, Bumrah went around the wicket to angle the ball into the left-hander
defended back to the bowler
length ball on the pads, too easy for Rinku who jumps back and clips the ball to the backward square leg boundary
good length angling into the right-hander, pushed into the covers for a single
chipped in the air towards the vacant mid-on region
defended on the front foot on the off side

drifts down the leg side, beats Tejasvi's sweep and also beats the keeper and runs to the boundary ... MI are reviewing the wide call, they think the ball hit something obviously. That ball bounced a fair bit, and brushed the glove! So runs for Tejasvi, he's up and running
driven back to the bowler

that is a stunning catch from Bosch at point! He leaps to his right at full stretch and intercepts a fierce cut shot with one hand, plucking it out of the air with his right and holding on to it as he crashes to the ground, Powell looks stunned. The TV umpire is checking if it is a clean catch and it is
clears the fielder on the long-on boundary! Powell plants his foot forward and slams a full ball clean over the boundary

Bumrah has a wicket, he dismisses Pandey for the first time in T20 cricket and celebrates rather effusively! Superb ball too. Pitches on a good length just outside off and nips sharply back into the right-hander, zipping past Pandey's attempted cut off the back foot and rattling the stumps. Pandey's gone after steadying KKR's chase and taking them close to a win that will keep them in the race for the last playoff spot
pushed off the back foot in front of point and they take on Jacks for a quick single, the throw misses at the bowler's end
gets behind the line of a good length ball and blocks
good length angling into off and middle, defended back to the bowler
pushed off the back foot through point
short of a length at the body, Powell swivels and pulls towards square leg
good length on middle stump, Pandey stays back and nudges the ball towards midwicket
moves across his stumps to flick but misses the ball by a long way and gets hit on the pad, that would have missed leg stump
good length angling into the right-hander, defended towards midwicket on the front foot
the slower ball but it is too wide outside off
tries to drive a full one down the ground but gets a thick inside edge towards midwicket
the bouncer, Powell swivels and then decides against pulling and bails out of the shot
dabbed off the back foot behind point for a single
now he gets down low, moving across his crease, to deftly play a fine paddle scoop to send the ball to the fine leg boundary
short ball with width outside off, Powell goes back and frees those powerful arms, the ball disappears to the cover boundary in a flash
pushed off the back foot to long on to bring up the fifty partnership
bowled flat around off, hit hard off the back foot in front of point
punched off the front foot through covers
Pandey moves towards the line of the ball tossed up at him outside off, waits for it to turn away, and then cuts late, beating backward point and finding the deep third boundary
full ball on middle and leg, flicked wide of the fielder at midwicket for a single
gets down on one knee and paddle scoops to fine leg
darted in quick just outside off, defended on the back foot to the bowler
pushed towards long off for another single
tossed up on a wicket to wicket line, driven hard down the ground to long on
pushed off the front foot to long off

edged but the slip fielder was moving to his right and the ball went between him and the keeper, Bosch and Rickelton look at each other after the chance slips past them, but it was a tough one, Powell's edged cut shot flew quickly
tossed up on off stump, driven towards long off
clears his front foot and flat-bats the ball with power past the bowler
cut off the back foot to deep point, shorter length this time
gets squared up on the back foot by one that floats on to a leg stump line and spins across Powell from a good length, played on the off side
tries to force the ball through the off side but gets a bottom edge into the ground back to the bowler
defended back to the bowler
dabbed off the back foot behind point towards deep third
short of a length outside off and Pandey uses the width to back away and cut to the deep third boundary
biffed down the ground right after that horrendous drop, Hardik will not be happy

astonishing mix up between Deepak Chahar and Robin Minz on the deep-backward square leg boundary! Powell top-edged the pull high towards the boundary, Chahar ran to his left from fine leg, Minz was going from square leg ... both of them got near the chance and then stopped and looked at each other as the ball fell between them. Minz pulled out a fraction earlier and so Chahar had to go for it, it was really his catch
on a good length angling into the right-hander, he gets behind the line and defends
tossed up outside off, driven to long off on the front foot, time for one of those time outs
squirted in front of square leg for a single again
sweeps it to short fine and they run a single to Bumrah
nudged through midwicket for another single
Powell dabs the quicker one as it moves away from him from a good length outside off towards cover for a single
drops short outside off, Pandey goes back and hits through cover
the free hit is a slower full ball outside off as Bosch misses the blockhole, Powell rocks the cover drive, hitting it with power to the boundary
Powell nearly loses balance as he tries to duck under and evade the bouncer from Bosch, good ball to end the over ... but but ... the siren goes off, signalling a no-ball
stays on the back foot and nudges a short of a length ball past the bowler for a single
short of a length at the hips, Powell nudges in front of square leg for a single
gets behind the line of a good length ball and blocks
that's how you deal with length deliveries on the pads! Powell swivels and whips it off his hips, high and far over deep square leg

straight to fine leg, the fielder barely had to move on the boundary! It was a length ball angling down leg side and Green swung across the line, hitting it flat and not high enough to clear Ghazanfar, KKR getting themselves into some trouble now
a single to wide mid-on to end the over, tight start from Ghazanfar
played gently to midwicket, another dot ball
defended on the back foot on the off side, that was a low full toss that Green chose not to attack
that's the one that spins away from the right-hander and Green had little clue about what it was about to do, he was beaten on the outside edge as he tried to defend
darted into the pads, worked off the back foot in front of square leg
full ball from Ghazanfar on middle stump, pushed towards mid on
cut hard into the ground and towards deep point for just a single
pushed towards cover point for a single, Pandey sprints through, Green takes gentler giant strides

caught behind! Extra bounce from a hard length just outside off, Rahane tries to punch off the back foot and gets an outside edge through to Rickelton, he didn't have much room outside off to work with
strays on to the pads with a full ball that Rahane glances wide of short fine leg and to the boundary
short delivery and Pandey swivels and pulls, times the shot superbly but there's a fielder on the square leg boundary
short of a length outside off, Pandey rocks back and cuts hard, beating backward point and finding the boundary again
played off the pads through square leg
lofts a length ball through the line and chips it back over the bowler's head and to the straight boundary

steps out but is in no position to play a proper shot to a short of a length delivery that nips into him and cramps him for room, gets beaten on the bottom edge as he tries to jam his bat down on the ball
short, too short, and down leg side too, might be wide on two counts
good length on a wicket to wicket line, Rahane gets behind it and blocks
short of a length around off, swatted to midwicket
pulled to deep backward square leg, gets to the fielder on the first bounce
too full and too straight, Rahane flicks and hits the ball along the ground to the square leg boundary, thickish inside edge that was
slower ball, nearly in the blockhole, played back to the bowler
played off the back foot to point
full length angling into the right-hander, Pandey plonks his foot forward and swings through the line, hitting the ball to the left of mid on and to the boundary
nips into the right-hander from a slightly shorter length, Rahane drops it close on the off side and runs the single
that is a classy shot from Rahane, leaning forward to a fullish ball outside off and caressing the square drive through point
good length around off, Pandey plays watchfully into the off side
presses forward and opens the face to steer a length ball from outside off to deep third
short of a length with width outside off, Rahane cuts firmly off the back foot but can't find the gap

appeal for lbw as the ball nips in from a good length and raps the pad as Rahane pushes forward to defend, MI want to review the not-out decision. The ball has missed the inside edge by a long way, but the impact on the pad and the projected impact on the wickets are both umpires's call, so Rahane will bat on
short of a length angling into the right-hander, Rahane plays a short-arm pull through midwicket and pierces the gap
Rahane slashes at a short of a length ball that pitches outside off and seams away and misses

turned him inside out and was that an edge that fell short of the keeper? No edge, but the ball moved away late after it beat the outside edge. Pandey was caught on his crease and beaten comprehensively
short of a length outside off, Pandey lets it go through to the keeper, some seam movement away from the right-hander
good length pitching outside off and angling in, Pandey defends on the off side. That was his first ball in competitive cricket since May 25, 2025
punches at a short of a length ball angling into him and gets a thick edge to deep third
short of a length at the body, Rahane gets behind the line and blocks
and the ball goes down leg side, with Rahane missing the glance
good length outside off, Rahane lets it go

dragged on! Allen tried to blitz that length ball outside off to the point boundary, this was a bit closer to his body than the previous two that he had hit for four and so he got an inside edge back on to his stumps. Chahar celebrates by putting his hand into his pocket and displaying an imaginary note, or did he forget to bring one?
the bouncer sails over Allen's head, that's too high
fuller length with shape into the right-hander on an off and middle line, Allen plays from his crease to mid on
and again, width outside off, Allen stands and delivers, driving the ball hard off the back foot past the diving fielder at cover
width outside off, and the length is just a bit shorter, giving Allen the space and time to go back and punch the ball hard through cover point
good length, pitching outside off and shaping away, Allen stays in his crease and punches towards point
good length outside off with movement away from the right-hander, Rahane stays in his crease and opens the fact of his bat to steer the ball to deep third
